response.overview: Oisin Devins follows the unstoppable master of Fortnite and god of golf as he faces his greatest challenger, Michael Cradock. After destroying Michael in Fortnite, golf, boxing and a lightsaber duel, Oisín is challenged one final time when Michael returns with bionic limbs and his great uncle Nick Eh 30. Just as Michael is about to finally win, Oisin hears the words “Low taper fade”, unleashing an overwhelming barrage of punches that sends Michael flying into space. Oisin remains undefeated.
response.title: The Adventures Of Oisin Devins
